//: Shared TypeScript settings for every workspace package.
Before this file existed, four packages (api, auth, db, ui) declared
'typecheck': 'tsc --noEmit' with no tsconfig.json anywhere -- not in the
package, not at the root. tsc with no project to read prints its help
text and exits 1, so `turbo run typecheck` reported 0 successful of 6
and had never once checked a type. packages/core was worse: its build
script is a bare 'tsc', which in the same situation exits 0 and emits
nothing, so the build reported success while compiling no files at all.
Paths are declared here so every package resolves the workspace packages
to source, matching what apps/web and apps/desktop already did.
